name: tether
description: Holds a project together across Claude Code sessions: an agents pane, watchers that wake the model only for news, and guards against expensive mistakes

configPath.title: Config file
configPath.description: Path of Tether's JSON config. Empty: .claude/tether.json in the session's folder.

checkpointEnabled.title: Checkpoint on
checkpointEnabled.description: Ask for a handoff, check it, clear and continue when the session is long and quiet.

checkpointContextTokens.title: Checkpoint at this many tokens
checkpointContextTokens.description: The main session context at which a checkpoint is due.

checkpointQuietSeconds.title: Quiet seconds before a checkpoint
checkpointQuietSeconds.description: Seconds with no typing and no new message of yours before the checkpoint acts. A new message of yours re-queues it.

checkpointTickSeconds.title: Checkpoint check interval (seconds)
checkpointTickSeconds.description: Seconds between checks of the session's state.

checkpointHandoffFile.title: Handoff file
checkpointHandoffFile.description: The handoff file, relative to the session folder.

checkpointMaxChars.title: Handoff size limit (characters)
checkpointMaxChars.description: The handoff is injected into the next session, so it must stay under this size.

checkpointInjectHandoff.title: Add the handoff at session start
checkpointInjectHandoff.description: When a session starts (new, resumed, cleared or compacted) and the handoff file exists, add its text to the session as context.

checkpointMaxRepairs.title: Handoff repair attempts
checkpointMaxRepairs.description: Repair attempts before the cycle gives up and the session carries on.

fleetEnabled.title: Fleet on
fleetEnabled.description: The agents pane, the status line and the SendMessage guard.

fleetCacheTtlMinutes.title: Agent cache lifetime (minutes)
fleetCacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache lives after an agent's last request (5, or 60 with subagentPromptCacheTtl 1h).

fleetBigContextTokens.title: Big agent context (tokens)
fleetBigContextTokens.description: Context size from which an expired cache is worth guarding.

fleetRetireContextTokens.title: Retire agent at (tokens)
fleetRetireContextTokens.description: Context size at which an agent is flagged for retirement.

fleetBigWaitTokens.title: BIG-WAIT at (tokens)
fleetBigWaitTokens.description: An agent with at least this context and a matching note (see the note pattern) is flagged BIG-WAIT. 0: off.

fleetBigWaitNote.title: BIG-WAIT note pattern
fleetBigWaitNote.description: A regular expression matched case-insensitively against the agent's annotation note. Empty: any note.

fleetColdGuard.title: Cold-cache guard
fleetColdGuard.description: Refuse SendMessage to a big agent whose cache has expired, unless the message starts with the override token.

fleetOverrideToken.title: Cold-cache override token
fleetOverrideToken.description: The text a message starts with to pass the cold-cache guard on purpose.

fleetShowSession.title: Show session context
fleetShowSession.description: Also show the main session context and the tightest rate limit in the status line.

fleetUsageWarnPercent.title: Rate limit warning (percent)
fleetUsageWarnPercent.description: A rate limit at or above this percent gets a !. Only shown with Show session context.

fleetRefreshSeconds.title: Fleet refresh (seconds)
fleetRefreshSeconds.description: Seconds between refreshes of the agent list, usage and annotations.

fleetCacheWarnMinutes.title: Cache warning (minutes left)
fleetCacheWarnMinutes.description: Cache minutes left at or under which the cache cell turns to the warning colour.

fleetEmoji.title: Emoji in the pane
fleetEmoji.description: An emoji per state and flag in the pane and /fleet text; off for plain text.

fleetColumnTint.title: Column tint
fleetColumnTint.description: true bands alternate columns with the theme colour, false divides columns with a bar, or give a colour. Empty: true.

fleetWatchState.title: Watch state file shown in the pane
fleetWatchState.description: A state file watch writes; when set the pane draws watch boxes under the table. Empty: none.

fleetPaneRows.title: Fleet pane rows
fleetPaneRows.description: Rows asked for the pane when inline above the prompt. 0: Claude Code decides.

fleetPaneColumns.title: Fleet pane columns
fleetPaneColumns.description: Columns asked for the pane when docked beside a fullscreen transcript. 0: Claude Code decides.

watchEnabled.title: Watch on
watchEnabled.description: The pollers and the findings they wake the model for.

watchMinWakeGapSeconds.title: Seconds between wakes
watchMinWakeGapSeconds.description: At least this long between two wakes; findings in between join the next one.

watchDeferWhileTypingMinutes.title: Defer wake while typing (minutes)
watchDeferWhileTypingMinutes.description: While you have a draft, a wake waits up to this long, then goes anyway.

watchTickSeconds.title: Countdown redraw (seconds)
watchTickSeconds.description: Seconds between redraws of the countdowns; 0 turns the live countdown off.

watchBoxRows.title: Log lines per poller box
watchBoxRows.description: Log lines each poller box shows.

watchWakePreamble.title: Wake message first line
watchWakePreamble.description: The first line of the wake prompt.
watchWakePreamble.default: watch found something new. Handle it or say why it can wait:

watchStoreName.title: Watch store name
watchStoreName.description: Names this project seen-set in the store, so two projects keep their own.

watchStateFile.title: Watch state file
watchStateFile.description: A file watch writes the boxes data to, for fleet to draw. Empty: none.

watchPaneRows.title: Watch pane rows
watchPaneRows.description: Rows asked for the pane when inline above the prompt. 0: Claude Code decides.

watchPaneColumns.title: Watch pane columns
watchPaneColumns.description: Columns asked for the pane when docked beside a fullscreen transcript. 0: Claude Code decides.

housekeepingEnabled.title: Housekeeping on
housekeepingEnabled.description: Tether folder, exclude lines, handoff template and handoff checks.

housekeepingFolder.title: Tether folder
housekeepingFolder.description: Tether folder in the project (conversation logs live in its conversations folder).

housekeepingCreateHandoff.title: Create a missing handoff
housekeepingCreateHandoff.description: Create the handoff from the template when it is missing.

housekeepingEnforceHandoff.title: Enforce the handoff template
housekeepingEnforceHandoff.description: Refuse a Write of the handoff that fails its check; report an Edit that leaves it failing.

conversationsEnabled.title: Conversation logs on
conversationsEnabled.description: Write each session to a log under the Tether folder.

conversationsMinSeconds.title: Seconds between log writes
conversationsMinSeconds.description: Seconds between log writes while turns complete; a log is always written before a clear.

stopEnabled.title: Stop guard on
stopEnabled.description: Block the end of a turn while PR problems or stopped agents nobody has dealt with are known.

stopMaxBlocks.title: Stop guard block limit
stopMaxBlocks.description: The same block this many times in a row, then let the turn end.
